description: This file contains implementation code for the security management of Access Points (AP) in a wireless network system. It handles security configurations, validation, and synchronization of security parameters such as modes, keys, and passphrases. It also includes functions for comparing security configurations between APs and managing security-related settings through dynamic management interfaces.
